# vendor/

`sigildex-0.1.0.tgz` is the `npm pack` output of the Sigildex CLI at the
revision this demo was built against, vendored only because the package is not
yet published to npm. The workflow pins its SHA-256 and verifies it before
installing. When `sigildex@0.1.0` is on the registry this directory goes away
and the workflow installs from npm, exactly as the upstream copy of the
workflow does.

SHA-256: `34d5e4fc2380fcf5dba68f45d5f3b7f531454ba2c5eb5bd1d28ab750da27a893`
